prompt.content:
You will be shown a photo of an analog instrument. Identify the instrument type and read its current value. Output ONLY valid JSON in this format:
{
  "instrument_type": "<type>",
  "reading": <number or HH:MM string>,
  "unit": "<unit>",
  "scale_max": <number or null>,
  "confidence": "<high|medium|low>"
}

For clocks, reading is HH:MM format.
For other instruments, reading is a number.
Output ONLY the JSON, no other text.
